correctness.rationale: In the fixed-s balls, b equally likely boxes model, U counts boxes with N_i>=1 and V those with N_i>=2. Summing diagonal and off-diagonal indicator covariances yields Cov(U,V)=bH_b(s), q=(b-1)/b,r=(b-2)/b. Independently enumerated all labelled allocations and compared exactly for b=3..6,s=2..6 (20 exact cases). H_b(x) combines three distinct real exponential bases r<q²<q with polynomial coefficients of degrees 1,1,0, so generalized Rolle bounds all real zeros counting multiplicity by 4; H(0)=H(1)=0, H′(1)<0, H(2)<0, H(x)>0 eventually; multiplicity/sign parity forces a unique root ξ_b>2. For b=2 direct allocation gives negative at s=2, zero at s=3, positive for s≥4. Uniform asymptotic expansion x=lambda b gives e^-lambda-(1+lambda+lambda²)e^-2lambda and yields ξ_b/b→unique positive λ solving exp(lambda)=1+lambda+lambda². Numerical ξ_3≈5.0464, ξ_10≈17.7317, ξ_100≈179.1617 corroborate but not prove infinite assertions.
residual_risks: Finite symbolic/numerical checks supplement, not replace, the quantified argument reconstructed from actual source; proof limitations stated explicitly.
